sources.title: BrunoHays/embeddinggemma-2-nullspace-audio - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: BrunoHays/embeddinggemma-2-nullspace-audio is google/embeddinggemma-2 with no change to the frozen weights, plus a frozen 256-dimensional null-space head that only acts on audio inputs.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma 2 model card | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model built by Google DeepMind which maps text (incl. code), images, video, and audio inputs—and combinations thereof—into a single, unified 768-dimensional vector space.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Performance EmbeddingGemma 2 delivers high-quality embeddings for code, vision, and audio tasks.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma model overview - Gemma Documentation
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a lightweight, open-source 740M parameter model designed for unified multimodal embeddings. Built on the Gemma 4 decoder architecture, it maps text, images, audio, and video into a unified 768-dimensional vector space.
